description: This file contains TypeScript code defining interfaces, utility functions, and a main function for caching and transforming OpenAI chat completion requests, specifically integrating with Anthropic strategies and cache control utilities.

methods.name: convertContentToBlocks
methods.description: Converts message content into content blocks suitable for processing, handling strings, numbers, and arrays.

methods.name: convertToAnthropic
methods.description: Transforms OpenAI chat completion parameters into an Anthropic-compatible message format, including system and message mappings.
